provenance.dataset: Hourly energy demand, generation and weather - Spain 2015-2018

calendar.definition: hour_sin/cos = sin/cos(2*pi*hour/24); month_sin/cos = sin/cos(2*pi*(month-1)/12); day_of_week 0=Mon; is_weekend = day_of_week>=5; sun elevation at mid-hour (NOAA)

anomaly.policy: alert = data_error rule OR nowcast band OR forecast band

assumptions.cost_basis: imbalance spread proxy: |price actual - price day ahead| (EUR/MWh) for each hour
